test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If each side of a cube is increased by 15%, then the volume of the cube will increase by : (Consider integral part only)
solution:
**Given:**

Increase in side of cube = 15%

**Concept:**

Volume of cube = Side³

**Calculation:**

⇒ Increase in volume = (1 + 15/100)³ - 1 = 0.51975 or 51.975%

**Hence, the volume of the cube will increase by approximately 52%.**
